reason: Concrete long-side breakout rules for US mid/large-cap stocks on daily bars with explicit scan, entry, stop and trail.

universe.description: mid caps and large caps, real companies, avoid dilutive small caps

setup.rule: stocks strong for past couple of months up to six months
setup.quote: i'll scan for stocks that have been strong strong for past couple of months up to like six months

setup.rule: tight consolidations for a couple weeks or couple days then break out of tight pattern
setup.quote: i'll find you know tight consolidations where a stock you know went up consolidated for a couple weeks or a couple days couple weeks and then starting to break out of a tight pattern

entry.rule: buy the breakout on daily, time on 5-min or at alert if not extended
entry.quote: i'll just buy the breakouts... i'll put it on like a five minute chart and i'll i'll wait for a dip or or i'll just buy the breakout on the daily

stop.rule: stop below low of the day
stop.quote: i'll see where the low of the day is and i'll put the stop below the low of the day

exits.rule: trail core with 10 or 20 EMA on daily, trim into strength
exits.quote: trail it with moving averages... it's either 10 or 20 ema on a daily chart

sizing.rule: risk per trade 1/6 to 1/8 of daily lockout (median green day x2)
sizing.quote: my risk per trade is a fraction of that number so let's say my risk per trade is like 1 8 or 1 6 of my daily lockout

ambiguities.issue: exact momentum_lookback_days and consolidation_days not numeric
